dialogues.jp:
することがなかった訳ではないけれど、まあ、
様子を見に来るくらいいいかなと思った。
dialogues.en:
There was no real reason to go there, but in the end, I
thought it was a good idea to check on it's condition.
dialogues.text:
There was no real reason to go there, but in the end, I
thought it was a good idea to check on it's condition.

dialogues.jp: 別に、面倒くさいことが起きる訳でもなし。
dialogues.en: I wasn't looking to create trouble or anything.
dialogues.text: I wasn't looking to create trouble or anything.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、美春ではないが、せっかく知り合ったの
だから、もう少し仲良くなってみたいと思う。
dialogues.en:
But since Miharu wasn't around, and we'd actually met, I
wanted to try to get closer to her.
dialogues.text:
But since Miharu wasn't around, and we'd actually met, I
wanted to try to get closer to her.

dialogues.jp: もちろん、月城アリスのことだ。
dialogues.en: Of course, I was talking about Tsukishiro Alice.
dialogues.text: Of course, I was talking about Tsukishiro Alice.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、月城がまたここに来てはいないかと足を
延ばしてみた。
dialogues.en:
Thinking that maybe she may not be here at this time, I
furtively approached the spot.
dialogues.text:
Thinking that maybe she may not be here at this time, I
furtively approached the spot.

dialogues.jp:
すると、例の場所に、ぽつんとしゃがんでいる
月城がいた。
dialogues.en:
But, as my view became clearer and clearer, so did the
figure of Tsukishiro.
dialogues.text:
But, as my view became clearer and clearer, so did the
figure of Tsukishiro.

dialogues.jp: 「月城ー」
dialogues.en: "Tsukshirooo-"
dialogues.text: "Tsukshirooo-"

dialogues.jp: 小さな月城がひょこっと俺の方を向く。
dialogues.en: The tiny Tsukishiro snapped her head towards me.
dialogues.text: The tiny Tsukishiro snapped her head towards me.

dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり来てたんだな」
dialogues.en: "You really did come here again."
dialogues.text: "You really did come here again."

dialogues.jp: こくんと頷く。
dialogues.en: A quick, barely noticable nod.
dialogues.text: A quick, barely noticable nod.

dialogues.jp:
「昼休憩に水をやりにくるのは、わかるけど、
　放課後まで何やってんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"I can understand it needing water during lunch break at
noon, but what are you doing here after school?"
dialogues.text:
"I can understand it needing water during lunch break at
noon, but what are you doing here after school?"

dialogues.jp:
月城が、もぞもぞと手袋を外して人形をこちら
に向ける。
dialogues.en:
Squirming, she once again removed her gloves and brought the
doll's head to face me.
dialogues.text:
Squirming, she once again removed her gloves and brought the
doll's head to face me.

dialogues.jp: 無垢な瞳が俺を見る。
dialogues.en:
Her innocence and purity were reflected in her eyes, as she
gazed at me.
dialogues.text:
Her innocence and purity were reflected in her eyes, as she
gazed at me.

dialogues.jp: なんとなく苦手な視線だ。
dialogues.en: She didn't look comfortable at all.
dialogues.text: She didn't look comfortable at all.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「放課後は、用務員のおじさんが草むしりをし
　たりするからね。見張ってないと！」
dialogues.en:
"If we don't watch out here after school, that old janitor
will come around and rip the plant out!"
dialogues.text:
"If we don't watch out here after school, that old janitor
will come around and rip the plant out!"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「……ずっと、そうやってじーっと見てるつも
　りか？」
dialogues.en:
"...So, you're gonna stay there the whole time, doing
nothing but staring at it?"
dialogues.text:
"...So, you're gonna stay there the whole time, doing
nothing but staring at it?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「用務員のおじさん、いつ来るかわからないか
　らね！　安心できないんだ」
dialogues.en:
"We don't know when or whether that old guy will come!! We
can't just let it happen."
dialogues.text:
"We don't know when or whether that old guy will come!! We
can't just let it happen."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「……来たら言えばいいだろ。これは抜いてく
　れるなって」
dialogues.en:
"...Tell him when he comes, then leave. You can't stay here
forever."
dialogues.text:
"...Tell him when he comes, then leave. You can't stay here
forever."

dialogues.jp: 月城がきょとんとした目で、俺の方を見る。
dialogues.en: Her eyes continued piercing into my very soul.
dialogues.text: Her eyes continued piercing into my very soul.

dialogues.jp: こいつら、気づいてなかったのか。
dialogues.en: Looks like she hasn't noticed it at all.
dialogues.text: Looks like she hasn't noticed it at all.

dialogues.jp:
ちょうど、その時用務員のおじさんが校庭から、
草をむしりながら、こちらへ向かってきた。
dialogues.en:
The said part-time janitor was already walking around,
pulling out the weeds around the campus.
dialogues.text:
The said part-time janitor was already walking around,
pulling out the weeds around the campus.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、すんませーん」
dialogues.en: "Ah, excuse me!"
dialogues.text: "Ah, excuse me!"

dialogues.jp:
俺は、用務員のおじさんのところに駆けていき、
適当に話をつけてきた。
dialogues.en: I ran up to the janitor, and started explaining.
dialogues.text: I ran up to the janitor, and started explaining.

dialogues.jp: 「それは、抜かないように気をつけるってさ」
dialogues.en: "He understands not to tear that plant out now."
dialogues.text: "He understands not to tear that plant out now."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「……ボクが行こうと思ってたのに」
dialogues.en: "...I thought I was supposed to go talk to him."
dialogues.text: "...I thought I was supposed to go talk to him."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「いや、どうせ、その人形で話しかけるんだろ？
　おっさん、ビビって逃げるぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Uh, you mean, letting this doll talk to him? He'd run off
screaming in terror first."
dialogues.text:
"Uh, you mean, letting this doll talk to him? He'd run off
screaming in terror first."

dialogues.jp:
俺みたいなヤツならいいけど、たいていの人間
はそういうのに耐性ないからな。
dialogues.en:
Not that I'm calling myself Mr. Congeniality, but I'm at
least human.
dialogues.text:
Not that I'm calling myself Mr. Congeniality, but I'm at
least human.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうかな」
dialogues.en: "T, that's true."
dialogues.text: "T, that's true."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「たぶんな」
dialogues.en: "Mmhmm."
dialogues.text: "Mmhmm."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「とにかく、その花はずっと見て無くても大丈
　夫ってことだ」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, it should be alright even if you don't stare at it
24-7 now."
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, it should be alright even if you don't stare at it
24-7 now."

dialogues.jp:
こんなひとけのないところ、外敵は用務員のお
じさんくらいだ。
dialogues.en:
In this deserted area, only that janitor would think of
encroaching this restricted space anyway.
dialogues.text:
In this deserted area, only that janitor would think of
encroaching this restricted space anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「何があるかわかんないから、もう少し様子を
　見てるって」
dialogues.en:
"We don't know what might happen... we'd continue keeping
watch for a bit longer."
dialogues.text:
"We don't know what might happen... we'd continue keeping
watch for a bit longer."

dialogues.jp:
月城と人形はそう言うと、またその草をじーっ
と見始めた。
dialogues.en:
As both Tsukishiro and Piros finished talking, they went
back to boring holes into the plant with their eyes.
dialogues.text:
As both Tsukishiro and Piros finished talking, they went
back to boring holes into the plant with their eyes.

dialogues.jp: 確かに、そうされちゃ誰も手は出せんわな。
dialogues.en: Seems like no one can stop them.
dialogues.text: Seems like no one can stop them.

dialogues.jp: 微動だにせずしゃがんでいる月城。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro continued squatting next to the plant, showing no
signs of movement at all.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro continued squatting next to the plant, showing no
signs of movement at all.

dialogues.jp:
時々、瞬きをしているのを除けば、腕の中の人
形だけでなく、月城本人も人形なんじゃないか
と思うくらいだ。
dialogues.en:
If it wasn't for her occasional blinking, you'd think that
what she was carrying wasn't the only doll around.
dialogues.text:
If it wasn't for her occasional blinking, you'd think that
what she was carrying wasn't the only doll around.

dialogues.jp:
「いつまで様子を見てるんだ？　そろそろ暗く
　なるぞ？」
dialogues.en:
"Are you really going to keep watching over it? It's going
to get dark soon, you know?"
dialogues.text:
"Are you really going to keep watching over it? It's going
to get dark soon, you know?"

dialogues.jp:
しばらく見ていた俺も、いい加減寒くなってき
たし、日も陰りが見えてきたので、そろそろ帰
ろうかと思い始めた。
dialogues.en:
Coldness had started to creep in the air, and the sun was
starting to fall behind the clouds; it was time to head
back.
dialogues.text:
Coldness had started to creep in the air, and the sun was
starting to fall behind the clouds; it was time to head
back.

dialogues.jp: 「家、近いんだからさ、一緒に帰らないか？」
dialogues.en: "Our houses are close, why don't we go home together?"
dialogues.text: "Our houses are close, why don't we go home together?"

dialogues.jp: 寒くなってきたっつーか、寒い！
dialogues.en: I'm starting to get the shivers, sheesh!
dialogues.text: I'm starting to get the shivers, sheesh!

dialogues.jp: 月城は、寒くないのか？
dialogues.en: Isn't she feeling cold now?
dialogues.text: Isn't she feeling cold now?

dialogues.jp: 肌だって、雪みたいに真っ白いのに……。
dialogues.en: Her skin even looks as white as snow...
dialogues.text: Her skin even looks as white as snow...

dialogues.jp:
２月も末の木枯らしは、あの細い身体には充分
こたえるはずだ。
dialogues.en:
That tiny body can't possibly stand up so long to the
freezing winds of the end of Feburary...
dialogues.text:
That tiny body can't possibly stand up so long to the
freezing winds of the end of Feburary...

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「先輩……サヨナラ」
dialogues.en: "Senpai... farewell."
dialogues.text: "Senpai... farewell."

dialogues.jp:
すっと立ち上がった月城は、そのまま傍らの鞄
を持って、すたすた走り始めた。
dialogues.en:
She suddenly stood up, taking the bag beside her, and ran
off.
dialogues.text:
She suddenly stood up, taking the bag beside her, and ran
off.

dialogues.jp: 「え、ちょっ、俺は？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Wait, I haven't...?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? Wait, I haven't...?"

dialogues.jp: 置いてくなんて、そりゃあないぞ。
dialogues.en: By the time I noticed, she'd all but disappeared.
dialogues.text: By the time I noticed, she'd all but disappeared.

dialogues.jp:
俺は月城を追いかけるが、なぜかすたすた走る
彼女に追いつくことができなかった。
dialogues.en:
I tried to chase after her, but the speed at which she ran
made her uncatchable.
dialogues.text:
I tried to chase after her, but the speed at which she ran
made her uncatchable.

dialogues.jp: なんだ、あの身軽さは。
dialogues.en: She's far more agile than I tbought.
dialogues.text: She's far more agile than I tbought.

dialogues.jp: 月城は、体育館の裏を抜け、桜公園の方に入る。
dialogues.en: Her figure raced into the Sakura Park opposite the gym,
dialogues.text: Her figure raced into the Sakura Park opposite the gym,

dialogues.jp:
俺もそれを追って、桜公園までどうにか走るが
その時はもう月城の姿はどこにもなかった。
dialogues.en: but by the time I reached there, she had vanished.
dialogues.text: but by the time I reached there, she had vanished.

dialogues.en: "She's fast..."
dialogues.text: "She's fast..."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、肩で息をしながら、辺りを見回すが、そ
れはもう静かなものだ。
dialogues.en:
Slowing down to catch my breath, the surroundings were
completely silent besides my panting.
dialogues.text:
Slowing down to catch my breath, the surroundings were
completely silent besides my panting.

dialogues.jp: 「仕方ない、チョコバナナでも買って帰るか」
dialogues.en: "Oh well, I'd buy a chocolate banana and head back."
dialogues.text: "Oh well, I'd buy a chocolate banana and head back."

dialogues.jp: 風邪を引く前に帰ろう。
dialogues.en: Better head home before I catch a cold.
dialogues.text: Better head home before I catch a cold.

dialogues.jp: ◆佇む月城◆
dialogues.en: ◆The Loitering Tsukishiro◆
dialogues.text: ◆The Loitering Tsukishiro◆

dialogues.jp:
体育館を訪れた俺は、そこでじーっと花を見つ
めている月城に出会った。
dialogues.en:
Visting the gym rear, I found Tsukishiro staring intently at
the flower there.
dialogues.text:
Visting the gym rear, I found Tsukishiro staring intently at
the flower there.

dialogues.jp:
どうやら、誰か来て、花を摘まれては困るので
できる限り見ているのだという。
dialogues.en:
Apparently, she was afraid some passerby would rip it out,
thinking it was a weed.
dialogues.text:
Apparently, she was afraid some passerby would rip it out,
thinking it was a weed.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、月城に代わり、用務員さんにあの花は摘
まないようにと伝える。
dialogues.en:
In Tsukishiro's stead, I explained to the janitor to ignore
the plant at the back of the gym.
dialogues.text:
In Tsukishiro's stead, I explained to the janitor to ignore
the plant at the back of the gym.

dialogues.jp:
そして、月城に一緒に帰ろうと誘ったのだが、
あっさりと断られてしまった……。
dialogues.en:
Then, I invited Tsukishiro to head back to our homes
together, but she more or less refused...
dialogues.text:
Then, I invited Tsukishiro to head back to our homes
together, but she more or less refused...
